items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 12 August 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

South or southeast 2 to 4, becoming mainly variable 3 or less later this afternoon, settling south or southwest 2 to 4 after midnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then risk of mist and fog patches in the south of the area later.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps poor or very poor in the south of the area later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 2 to 4, veering west or northwest 3 to 5 overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Risk of mist and fog patches patches for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally poor or very poor in any mist and fog patches.
